evidence: X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) with an Al Kα source at 1486.6 eV was performed ex-situ to determine the chemical composition of Er-doped Y2O3 thin films. To characterize the optical properties of erbium-doped Y2O3 films, room-temperature photoluminescence (PL) measurements were conducted using an Ar+ laser tuned to 488 nm as the pump source.
